name: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited
summary: Vitasoy International Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells food and beverages in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Australia, New Zealand, and Singapore. The company offers soya milk and related products, tea, water, juice, tofu, etc. It also operates tuck shops and catering business, as well as invests in properties. The company sells its products through distributors and retailers. Vitasoy International Holdings Limited was founded in 1940 and is based in Tuen Mun, Hong Kong.
